branches.name: codex/fix-high-priority-issues-from-codex-review
branches.unique_work: Security fix in DeskSeal (sealed DM client): the AES-GCM pair key was captured once at arm time; if the peer token transferred while the page stayed open, every later send kept encrypting to the former holder's key. Fix re-reads the recipient's published key on chain before every encryption and falls back to plaintext with a warning if it is absent or rotated; verify-site drives arm -> transfer -> send and asserts the log's sealed flag is 0. Also tools/redeploy-site.mjs --new-parley to deliberately start a new Parley archive (old address recorded in rec.archivedParleys) when registry semantics change.
branches.why: Concrete confidentiality bug in the messaging layer the GOAL requires; small, tested fix. Parley migration flag is a useful operational pattern for retiring an on-chain message archive.

branches.name: codex/fix-issues-from-codex-review-#31
branches.unique_work: Security fix for the Uniswap v4 Facet hook: syncFee() copied the live artwork section at mining time, so an ERC-4907 renter could commit a new orientation between the owner's read and the sync and set the pool fee the owner never saw. Fix: syncFee(uint256 expectedSection) reverting SectionMoved on mismatch; launch page gains a 'Synchronize fee to the current section' control that reads the Facet's own TOKEN()/HUB() and sectionOf and carries the expectation; copy corrected to state snapshot semantics; new verify-launch test 'a renter cannot front-run the section the owner approved'. Base Facet.syncFee() still takes no argument.
branches.why: Front-running fix on the launchpad's dynamic-fee hook; must also be applied to GateFacet from the hciyvv branch.

branches.name: codex/list-nft-functions-and-suggest-upgrades-hciyvv
branches.unique_work: Parallel line to the merged PR #38 with two further commits. Unique vs base: (1) src/GateFacet.sol, one immutable v4 hook combining launch gate (NotOpenYet before OPENS), liquidity lock (StillLocked for negative liquidityDelta until UNLOCKS, zero-delta fee collection still allowed) and artwork-driven dynamic fee between FLOOR and CEILING; Kiln.gateFacetArg packing and recipe kind 2; GateFacet.t.sol. (2) V4PositionPlanner hardening: authority via KILN.mayActAs only (base also requires launcher==msg.sender, which strands authority after an NFT transfer); increase/decrease/collect/burn plans read the real PoolKey from PositionManager.getPoolAndPositionInfo instead of a caller-supplied key (base let the form substitute SETTLE_PAIR/TAKE_PAIR currencies); mintPlan prices liquidity from Uniswap StateView.getSlot0 with livePrice() reporting the block. (3) Launch page: 'manage a position' section (inspect/collect/increase/decrease/burn), Permit2 allowance read/skip/revoke, explicit position-owner-and-fee-controller selector, Desk.wait receipt helper so each launch stage waits for confirmation; new verify-launch assertions; README paragraph; stateView/v4Positions/permit2 chain config.
branches.why: Launchpad security and feature work beyond what the base merged: authority-follows-the-NFT and PoolKey-from-PositionManager are correctness/security fixes; GateFacet is the schedule+lock+artwork-fee hook. Needs rebasing onto the base's planner and the #31 syncFee fix applied to GateFacet; ignore the deployment-record deletions a two-dot diff would imply.

branches.name: codex/propose-fix-for-custody-vulnerability
branches.unique_work: Commit 4b0b35b 'Authenticate ENS name custody' is not an ancestor of the base, but its content is: base Nameplate has the NAME_WRAPPER immutable, wrapper-only _ownsNode/heldBy ('Registry control is not NFT custody') and verify-plate's 'registry control cannot counterfeit custody' test. Vulnerability it closed: heldBy trusted any code-bearing registry owner's ownerOf answer, so a fake wrapper could counterfeit custody for any token's account, and plain registry control (reclaimable by the .eth registrant) counted as custody.
branches.why: Already in base in substance; nothing unique to port. Write-up kept in the report for the record.

branches.name: idfbi-isolated-ci-20260904
branches.unique_work: A GitHub workflow plus seven base64 payload files that reconstruct a sha256-locked tarball (3c3be7ea...) and run forge build --sizes / forge test on it. The tarball is a complete separate Foundry project 'i dont fucking believe it!' (symbol IDFBI, ImpossibleNFT): ERC-721 'organism' with commit-reveal mint and proof-routed evolutions with nullifiers, ERC-7496 trait events, ImpossibleAccount (ERC-6551 + ERC-7579 modular + ERC-4337), AgentKernel (ERC-7579 executor + on-chain agent/tool registry with access predicates, memory receipts, reputation, attestations), SessionKeyExecutor, P256PasskeyValidator, CapsuleVault (content-addressed deduplicating bytecode storage), MultiverseMirror (bridge-agnostic proof-adapter state mirroring), ImpossibleRenderer, tests and deploy scripts. Decoded copy at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/9872dd98-bd4a-5b4c-9579-cffc2e916f05/scratchpad/idfbi/x/.
branches.why: Not mergeable as a tarball, and invisible to grep, but a strong design reference for the agent/vault/cross-chain parts of the GOAL (passkey validator, capsule vault, mirror) that neither IPSEITY nor ANIMA has in this form. If it is one of the four repositories, take its source from that repo instead.

highlights: claude/claude-md-docs-8vvyc8 is the only branch implementing the holder-gated web app surface the GOAL needs: TRADE (maker bench + quote-first swap with exact approve, floor, deadline), HAND (loan/bolt/transfer in ascending finality) and SPEAK (Parley back-pointer walk + cross-chain 'HEARD FROM OTHER CHAINS' via the LayerZero port) lanes, with a 29-selector on-chain table in ConsoleRead.sels(), invariants 150-156, 96 Chromium-driven assertions, and three live Base Sepolia Premises (0xd4e64108..., 0xc64dff66..., 0xa2519f12...). None of it is in the base.

Three unmerged security fixes never reached the base: (1) DeskSeal sealed DMs kept encrypting to a former holder's key after the peer token transferred while the page was open; fix revalidates the published key before every send. (2) Facet.syncFee() let an ERC-4907 renter front-run the owner's fee approval by turning the artwork mid-flight; fix syncFee(expectedSection) + SectionMoved. (3) Sepolia config used the mainnet ENS NameWrapper (0xD4416b13...) so wrapped-name custody fails on Sepolia; fix 0x0635513f179D50A207757E05759CbD106d7dFcE8.

codex/list-nft-functions-and-suggest-upgrades-hciyvv carries launchpad work beyond the merged PR #38: GateFacet (immutable gate + liquidity lock + artwork-driven fee hook, zero-delta fee collection allowed during lock), V4PositionPlanner authority via mayActAs only (base strands authority after an NFT transfer), PoolKey read from PositionManager instead of a caller-supplied pair, StateView live pricing, full position lifecycle UI with Permit2 read/revoke and receipt-awaiting launch stages.

codex/propose-fix-for-custody-vulnerability (wrapper-only ENS custody, anti-counterfeit) is already in the base in substance; five other 'ahead' branches are merge-commit wrappers or byte-identical duplicates (iodub2, locate-container-key, facet-pool-fee, sealing-client, -tlo4vf).

idfbi-isolated-ci-20260904 hides an entire separate Foundry project (IDFBI / ImpossibleNFT: ERC-6551+7579+4337 account, AgentKernel tool registry, P256 passkey validator, session keys, CapsuleVault, MultiverseMirror) inside base64 payload files; decoded to the scratchpad as a design reference.

Preflight fix (deployment-budget.mjs) adds a 0.05 ETH rollup L1-data-fee reserve after a Base Sepolia deployment measured 0.0214 ETH against an underquoting preflight; the base is now Ethereum-only (codex/restrict-to-ethereum-only merged), so all Base Sepolia records across these branches are historical.

The base's own deployment records disagree: DEPLOYMENTS.md 'Live now' names Base Sepolia Premises 0x01de7b5d... while deployments/base-sepolia.json names 0xc59f75d2...; the docs branch would move both to 0xa2519f12... (2026-08-24).
